title.zh: Google Nano Banana 2 与 2 Lite 生图模型上线

summary.en: Google official Nano Banana 2 (gemini-3.1-flash-image) and Nano Banana 2 Lite (gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image) are now available on OmniMux.
summary.zh: Google 官方新一代生图模型 Nano Banana 2（gemini-3.1-flash-image）与 Nano Banana 2 Lite（gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image）已正式上线 OmniMux。

body.en:
## Google Nano Banana 2 Series

Google official Nano Banana 2 series image generation models are now live on OmniMux.

### Model Details

- **Nano Banana 2 (Standard):** `gemini-3.1-flash-image` ($0.067 / image at 1K)
- **Nano Banana 2 Lite (Economy):** `gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image` ($0.0336 / image at 1K)
- **Endpoint:** `POST /v1/images/generations`

High-speed generation with up to 4K resolution support and multi-aspect-ratio outputs.
body.zh:
## Google Nano Banana 2 系列生图模型

Google 官方新一代 Nano Banana 2 系列生图模型已正式在 OmniMux 上线。

### 模型规格

- **Nano Banana 2 稳定版：** `gemini-3.1-flash-image`（官方 1K 基准价 $0.067/张）
- **Nano Banana 2 Lite 低价跑量版：** `gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image`（官方 1K 基准价 $0.0336/张）
- **调用端点：** `POST /v1/images/generations`

支持极速超清出图与多种自由长宽比。
